notes.subject: fix(mcp): show 2026-07-28 URL elicitation instead of silently declining
notes.summary: MCP URL elicitation requests on the 2026-07-28 revision, which carry no elicitationId, are now shown to the user instead of being silently declined.

notes.subject: feat(agent): ask with ask_user instead of ending turns waiting for input
notes.summary: Where ask_user is available, the agent now asks with an ask_user card instead of ending turns with waiting_for_user, which is no longer offered and is rejected there; hosts like the Assistant keep waiting_for_user.

notes.subject: fix(webview): show attached documents and accept dropped media in Ask Agent
notes.summary: Attached documents now appear as named chips in user messages, and the composer accepts dropped images and documents when media paste is allowed without workspace attachments.
